# Wordwall

> > Wordwall is an interactive educational activity platform for creating customizable learning games, quizzes, and exercises across multiple languages and subjects.

Wordwall provides teachers and educators with templates for creating engaging educational content including anagrams, flashcards, matching activities, quizzes, and speaking cards. The platform supports multilingual education spanning English, Spanish, Arabic, Thai, Tagalog, Kazakh, and many other languages, with activities covering language learning, mathematics, science, and social-emotional learning.

## Key Topics

- Interactive learning activities
- Language learning exercises
- Educational quizzes and games
- Anagram games
- Flashcards and vocabulary
- Speaking cards
- Grammar practice
- Multilingual education
- ESL/EFL teaching
- Mathematics activities
- Phonics instruction
- Arabic language learning
- Spanish language learning
- Open-the-box activities
- IB curriculum resources

## Language Learning Activities

- [Irregular verbs part 3 Game2 - Anagram](https://wordwall.net/resource/108935135/angielski/irregular-verbs-part-3-game2): English irregular verbs anagram game with Polish translations
- [Vocab 05.03 - Flash cards](https://wordwall.net/resource/108935246/vocab-0503): English-Russian vocabulary flashcards for language learning
- [Adjectives -ED / -ING (a write-in) - Type the answer](https://wordwall.net/resource/108934745/adjectives-ed-ing-a-write-in): English participial adjectives fill-in exercise for grammar practice
- [Unit 6 Lesson 4: Since and for - Form a Question - Flash cards](https://wordwall.net/resource/108934009/%D8%A5%D9%86%D8%AC%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%B2%D9%8A/unit-6-lesson-4): Present perfect since/for question formation flashcards for Grade 7 ESL
- [Tunog at Letra: Buuin ang Salita - Anagram](https://wordwall.net/resource/108935243/tunog-at-letra-buuin-ang-salita): Tagalog phonics anagram game by Jonnalyn11 for word-building practice
- [MFS. Lesson 6 - Speaking cards](https://wordwall.net/resource/108934967/mfs-lesson-6): MFS phonics lesson 6 speaking cards for word practice
- [4th Quarter Review Activity - Spin the wheel](https://wordwall.net/resource/108934729/esl/4th-quarter-review-activity): ESL 4th quarter review covering reading comprehension and language mechanics

## Spanish Language Resources

- [LA CORTESÍA, PEDIR Y EXCUSARSE - Unjumble](https://wordwall.net/resource/108934961/spanyol/la-cortes%C3%ADa-pedir-y-excusarse): Spanish politeness phrases unjumble by Castroevelyn for courtesy practice
- [Indentidades - 4. Bienestar físico (IB Spanish Ab Initio) - Unjumble](https://wordwall.net/resource/108933959/indentidades-4-bienestar-f%C3%ADsico-ib-spanish-ab-initio): IB Spanish Ab Initio physical wellness unjumble by Cynthiacu
- [LOS MESES DEL AÑO - Quiz](https://wordwall.net/resource/108935055/los-meses-del-a%C3%B1o): Spanish months vocabulary quiz by Macarena2 for English-Spanish translation

## Arabic Language & Culture

- [حدد وظيفة كل جزء من اجزاء الاذن - Match up](https://wordwall.net/resource/108934419/%D8%AD%D8%AF%D8%AF-%D9%88%D8%B8%D9%8A%D9%81%D8%A9-%D9%83%D9%84-%D8%AC%D8%B2%D8%A1-%D9%85%D9%86-%D8%A7%D8%AC%D8%B2%D8%A7%D8%A1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%B0%D9%86): Arabic ear anatomy matching activity for auditory system learning

## Mathematics & STEM

- [Matematik tahun 3 tambah tiga nombor - Open the box](https://wordwall.net/resource/108934226/math/matematik-tahun-3-tambah-tiga-nombor): Malaysian Year 3 math addition of three numbers interactive quiz
- [Time zone reading MATHs - Quiz](https://wordwall.net/resource/108935271/time-zone-reading-maths): UTC time zone conversion quiz featuring Moscow, Tokyo, London, New York
- [Өсімдіктердің жынысcыз және жынысты көбею - Quiz](https://wordwall.net/resource/108934259/%D3%A9%D1%81%D1%96%D0%BC%D0%B4%D1%96%D0%BA%D1%82%D0%B5%D1%80%D0%B4%D1%96%D2%A3-%D0%B6%D1%8B%D0%BD%D1%8B%D1%81c%D1%8B%D0%B7-%D0%B6%D3%99%D0%BD%D0%B5-%D0%B6%D1%8B%D0%BD%D1%8B%D1%81%D1%82%D1%8B-%D0%BA%D3%A9%D0%B1%D0%B5%D1%8E%D1%96): Kazakh biology quiz on plant sexual and asexual reproduction
